interpretation: CAUTION - these containment relations are NOT occlusion and NOT z-order. SAM 2.1 automatic mask generation returns NESTED masks (a whole-object mask plus part and sub-part masks), so a small mask lying inside a large mask's bounding box is the normal nesting case and can be produced with no occlusion present at all. Measured consequence for downstream tasks: mask count must NOT be treated as object/role count on this source.
occlusion_status: NOT_DEMONSTRATED: no occlusion event was measured in this window. This is a limitation of mask-geometry evidence on this source, not proof the source contains no occlusion.
z_order_note: SAM 2.1 automatic masks are disjoint or nested, so which surface is in FRONT cannot be measured from masks alone; z-order is recorded as unresolved instead of guessed.
